mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate consistently lowers the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market weakness that triggers reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) consistently boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% sustained for three consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy that dampens economic growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy stance, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.02.
